page_title: WOL 1-2 LIV | Wolves v Liverpool 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
90+4' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+1' Carlos Forbs (Wolves) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Joe Gomez (Liverpool) has come on for Andrew Robertson.
87' Carlos Forbs (Wolves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
87' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
85' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 2:9.
83' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
83' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
82' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) will take the corner.
82' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
79' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) will take a corner kick.

78' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
77' Substitution. Santiago Bueno leaves the pitch and is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
76' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
76' A quickly taken corner by Wolves.
74' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
73' Arne Slot has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Curtis Jones (Liverpool) replacing Dominik Szoboszlai.
73' Here comes a substitution. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Luis Diaz.
73' Corner kick. Wolves will have an opportunity.
72' Carlos Forbs (Wolves) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
71' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Liverpool.
70' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
68' That's the end of the game for Jorgen Strand Larsen, who is replaced by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves).

68' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
67' Carlos Forbs (Wolves) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
65' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
64' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
63' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
61' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Sam Johnstone no chance!
60' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
60' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
60' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Liverpool as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.

59' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Liverpool!
56' 1 - 1 Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) pounces on a rebound inside the box from a Carlos Forbs shot and sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:1.
55' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
54' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but Sam Johnstone comes off his line to gather the ball.
52' Substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde is replaced by Carlos Forbs (Wolves).
52' Joao Gomes (Wolves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Liverpool.
50' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
49' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' 0 - 1 Goal! Diogo Jota plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the bottom right corner from close range. 0:1.
45+1' A dangerous looking corner kick from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is cleared to safety by the defence.
45+1' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Liverpool have a corner.
45+1' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Mario Lemina (Wolves) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
43' Foul! Mario Lemina (Wolves) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
41' Liverpool earn a corner.

40' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Sam Johnstone, who pulls off a decent save! Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
36' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
35' Mario Lemina (Wolves) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
35' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Diogo Jota (Liverpool) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

32' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) controls the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up low in the middle of the goal but for a magnificent save by Sam Johnstone.
30' Andre (Wolves) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
28' A cross from a corner kick by Liverpool is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
28' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
26' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
25' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Joao Gomes (Wolves).
24' The shots on goal statistics – 2:0.

22' A sweet pass finds Matheus Cunha (Wolves) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Alisson is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
21' An attempted cross from Mario Lemina (Wolves) is cleared.
19' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
16' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
16' Sam Johnstone (Wolves) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
15' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes.
12' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
11' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sam Johnstone intercepts the ball.
10' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' Anthony Taylor blows for a foul after Diogo Jota (Liverpool) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
6' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
5' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) tested Alisson with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
2' Wolves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Liverpool will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Anthony Taylor.
